look.summary_zh: 中性 · 中灰近原值 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 129.0/255（变化 +1.5 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.215。中灰红减蓝 +1.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EBDACD、#CE977A、#6C3923；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #AC0606、#9AC726、#2233B4。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 129.0/255 (+1.5 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.215; mid-gray red minus blue +1.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EBDACD, #CE977A, #6C3923. Red/green/blue swatches: #AC0606, #9AC726, #2233B4.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
